heading_path: Buyer's Guide Manage a contract - Vendor performance
blocks.markdown: ## Vendor performance
blocks.plain_text: Vendor performance

heading_path: Buyer's Guide Manage a contract - Vendor performance
blocks.markdown: This section outlines how to manage vendor performance effectively to protect Canada's interests. By following these guidelines, you can ensure that contracts are fulfilled as agreed and address any issues promptly to maintain high standards of performance.
blocks.plain_text: This section outlines how to manage vendor performance effectively to protect Canada's interests. By following these guidelines, you can ensure that contracts are fulfilled as agreed and address any issues promptly to maintain high standards of performance.

heading_path: Buyer's Guide Manage a contract - Vendor performance
blocks.markdown: ### Contract performance
blocks.plain_text: Contract performance

heading_path: Buyer's Guide Manage a contract - Vendor performance
blocks.markdown: Managing a contract involves multiple activities to ensure the contract's fulfillment. Changes in circumstances like the contractor's failure to meet obligations, disputes over contract conditions or necessary amendments after awarding the contract might disrupt contract performance.
blocks.plain_text: Managing a contract involves multiple activities to ensure the contract's fulfillment. Changes in circumstances like the contractor's failure to meet obligations, disputes over contract conditions or necessary amendments after awarding the contract might disrupt contract performance.

heading_path: Buyer's Guide Manage a contract - Vendor performance
blocks.markdown: In cases where contract fulfillment is at risk, you should take the necessary steps to protect Canada's interests. This includes dealing with disputes promptly, fairly and keeping procurement records up-to-date to document the actions taken.
blocks.plain_text: In cases where contract fulfillment is at risk, you should take the necessary steps to protect Canada's interests. This includes dealing with disputes promptly, fairly and keeping procurement records up-to-date to document the actions taken.

heading_path: Buyer's Guide Manage a contract - Vendor performance
blocks.markdown: ### Timely performance
blocks.plain_text: Timely performance

heading_path: Buyer's Guide Manage a contract - Vendor performance
blocks.markdown: If a contractor fails to deliver goods or services as scheduled, you must review the reasons for the delay in consultation with the client and legal services. Should the delay be due to uncontrollable factors and not caused by the contractor’s fault or negligence, you should extend the contract duration by a period equivalent to the delay. Otherwise, the contractor is accountable for any non-delivery.
blocks.plain_text: If a contractor fails to deliver goods or services as scheduled, you must review the reasons for the delay in consultation with the client and legal services. Should the delay be due to uncontrollable factors and not caused by the contractor’s fault or negligence, you should extend the contract duration by a period equivalent to the delay. Otherwise, the contractor is accountable for any non-delivery.

heading_path: Buyer's Guide Manage a contract - Vendor performance
blocks.markdown: Note: Excusable delays are detailed in general conditions.
blocks.plain_text: Note: Excusable delays are detailed in general conditions.

heading_path: Buyer's Guide Manage a contract - Vendor performance
blocks.markdown: In cases of default you may terminate the contract, fully or partially, after issuing a written notice to the contractor.
blocks.plain_text: In cases of default you may terminate the contract, fully or partially, after issuing a written notice to the contractor.

heading_path: Buyer's Guide Manage a contract - Vendor performance
blocks.markdown: If the contract is backed by surety bonds and requires an extension due to uncontrollable delays, you must:
blocks.plain_text: If the contract is backed by surety bonds and requires an extension due to uncontrollable delays, you must:

heading_path: Buyer's Guide Manage a contract - Vendor performance
blocks.markdown:
- obtain approval from the surety company before extending the contract's completion dates
- seek the surety's agreement before modifying the contract price for additional work, if necessary
blocks.plain_text: obtain approval from the surety company before extending the contract's completion dates ; seek the surety's agreement before modifying the contract price for additional work, if necessary

heading_path: Buyer's Guide Manage a contract - Vendor performance
blocks.markdown: #### Handling terminations and amendments
blocks.plain_text: Handling terminations and amendments

heading_path: Buyer's Guide Manage a contract - Vendor performance
blocks.markdown: When a contract is terminated for default or a conditional amendment is issued, the contractor must be formally notified in writing of the performance issue.
blocks.plain_text: When a contract is terminated for default or a conditional amendment is issued, the contractor must be formally notified in writing of the performance issue.

heading_path: Buyer's Guide Manage a contract - Vendor performance
blocks.markdown: This notification should mention that Canada may consider the poor performance for future VPCM assessments and that it will result in a note in the VIM system.
blocks.plain_text: This notification should mention that Canada may consider the poor performance for future VPCM assessments and that it will result in a note in the VIM system.

heading_path: Buyer's Guide Manage a contract - Vendor performance
blocks.markdown: For terminations for default and conditional amendments, you must consult with legal services. For a conditional amendment, include the following text in the notification:
blocks.plain_text: For terminations for default and conditional amendments, you must consult with legal services. For a conditional amendment, include the following text in the notification:

heading_path: Buyer's Guide Manage a contract - Vendor performance
blocks.markdown: “The parties agree to this amendment on condition that Canada has the rights to consider the poor performance, which has led to this conditional amendment, for the purpose of assessing whether a VPCM will be placed against the contractor. The parties agree that this conditional amendment will result in a note in the VIM System, and will trigger a VPCM assessment process at the end of the contract or expiry date of the Standing Offer.”
blocks.plain_text: “The parties agree to this amendment on condition that Canada has the rights to consider the poor performance, which has led to this conditional amendment, for the purpose of assessing whether a VPCM will be placed against the contractor. The parties agree that this conditional amendment will result in a note in the VIM System, and will trigger a VPCM assessment process at the end of the contract or expiry date of the Standing Offer.”

Vendor Performance Corrective Measure Assessment process
blocks.markdown: ### Vendor Performance Corrective Measure Assessment process
blocks.plain_text: Vendor Performance Corrective Measure Assessment process

heading_path: Buyer's Guide Manage a contract - Vendor performance
Vendor Performance Corrective Measure Assessment process
blocks.markdown: A contract terminated for default or with a conditional amendment triggers a mandatory assessment to determine whether a VPCM is to be applied.
blocks.plain_text: A contract terminated for default or with a conditional amendment triggers a mandatory assessment to determine whether a VPCM is to be applied.

heading_path: Buyer's Guide Manage a contract - Vendor performance
Vendor Performance Corrective Measure Assessment process
blocks.markdown: Upon learning of a default, the VPCM coordinator sends a reminder email to the buyers outlining the initial steps. You must respond within 5 business days and check the VPCM database for any existing assessments related to the contractor.
blocks.plain_text: Upon learning of a default, the VPCM coordinator sends a reminder email to the buyers outlining the initial steps. You must respond within 5 business days and check the VPCM database for any existing assessments related to the contractor.

heading_path: Buyer's Guide Manage a contract - Vendor performance
Vendor Performance Corrective Measure Assessment process
blocks.markdown: If no ongoing assessments affect the contractor, you will receive authorization to proceed with the VPCM assessment. If there is an ongoing assessment, you will be informed that the authorization for assessment of the new case will be put on hold until the previous assessment is completed.
blocks.plain_text: If no ongoing assessments affect the contractor, you will receive authorization to proceed with the VPCM assessment. If there is an ongoing assessment, you will be informed that the authorization for assessment of the new case will be put on hold until the previous assessment is completed.

heading_path: Buyer's Guide Manage a contract - Vendor performance
Vendor Performance Corrective Measure Assessment process
blocks.markdown: The assessment must be completed within 3 months from the authorization date.
blocks.plain_text: The assessment must be completed within 3 months from the authorization date.

heading_path: Buyer's Guide Manage a contract - Vendor performance
blocks.markdown: ### Recordkeeping in the VIM system
blocks.plain_text: Recordkeeping in the VIM system

heading_path: Buyer's Guide Manage a contract - Vendor performance
blocks.markdown: Notes in the VIM system related to contract termination or conditional amendments remain for 6 years. The note may be removed sooner where the termination or conditional amendment contributed to the VPCM assessment.
blocks.plain_text: Notes in the VIM system related to contract termination or conditional amendments remain for 6 years. The note may be removed sooner where the termination or conditional amendment contributed to the VPCM assessment.

heading_path: Buyer's Guide Manage a contract - Vendor performance
blocks.markdown: Canada reserves the right to include notes called “Other Performance Records” in the VIM system where other significant issues pertaining to performance are observed. These notes are subject to the approval of the appropriate ADM , Acquisitions Program, PSPC .
blocks.plain_text: Canada reserves the right to include notes called “Other Performance Records” in the VIM system where other significant issues pertaining to performance are observed. These notes are subject to the approval of the appropriate ADM , Acquisitions Program, PSPC .

Provisions for stop work orders, contract suspensions, and other reasons for offer rejection
blocks.markdown: The VPCM provisions do not override PSPC 's rights regarding stop work orders, contract or supply arrangement suspensions, standing offer set-asides and offer rejections.
